process_fixes_ranked.name: Run gate-chain and framework-backlog before the first review; rank walker open rows

process_fixes_ranked.name: Composed-interaction gate for framework changes
process_fixes_ranked.change: A pointer fixture page per block (hover, focus, open) with element screenshots and a computed check on the combined result.
process_fixes_ranked.why: Framework-side; the review agent hovers and focuses each block's controls in a real clone.

process_fixes_ranked.name: Live delivery check per record x target x state (replaces the delivery-map done marks)
process_fixes_ranked.change: lib/delivery-map.mjs: skip *.shell.json; every bound node must carry the layer (every, not some); evidence read from the live mirror (getAnimations, computed from-opacity after the entrance, hover end state under a real pointer) per record per target; keyed to Fill's id space; flip all 150 open U14 keys through it. It also reads back every written entrance so a framework override (HP2 LCP rule) shows.
process_fixes_ranked.risk: low: read-only; only the done marks change meaning

process_fixes_ranked.change: Add solve to site-run.mjs::ALL_STAGES, or a states-only pass writing hover, focus and active settings from forced-pseudo reads.

process_fixes_ranked.why: Large and risky across 40 surfaces. Tool-now only for the chrome (header, footer, drawer, 4 megas), where Solve already runs on the header. Pages: the review agent forces hover and focus on every interactive element of each page and files the differing rows.

process_fixes_ranked.risk: low: two reads and one rule
